notes: v476 — there is now a proper box for the auto-trade bridge key, in ⚙ Advanced settings, so you never have to type anything into a browser console. It has a 🧪 Test it button that actually asks your server whether the key works and tells you which of the four possible answers it got — accepted, rejected, bridge not switched on, or no answer at all — rather than just saying "saved". Pressing it queues nothing. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
